versions.changelog: Method upgrade: consensus-buster (beat the modal answer, not reproduce it), mandatory dated-source retrieval, mid-band calibration discipline, still-contested exit. New bundled CONNECTORS.md (copy-paste recipes for arXiv/Semantic Scholar/PubMed/Crossref/OpenAlex/Reddit/HN/GitHub/yt-dlp + Exa/Tavily/Brave). Runtime-aware KB-root resolution; zero-setup blessing (web search alone suffices).
Method: retrieval discipline (hybrid + reformulate), grounded/debiased judging, single-writer fan-out. Adds eval harness (trigger + capability ablation + regression).
Initial release — track-record-weighted expertise, falsifiable stances, cite-or-flag, compounding KB.
